summary: First test iteration on Potato Management ERP. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed covering auth, masters CRUD, purchases/sales with amount computation (bag & weight basis), sales-to-farmer auto ledger debit, potato-purchase-from-farmer auto ledger credit, credit-note auto ledger + cascade delete, ledger running balance, manual ledger add/delete, auto-entry deletion rejected (400), stock computation, potato lot-wise stock, dashboard summary, reports transactions, and invoices filter. Frontend: 11/11 critical UI flows passed via Playwright including landing page, bad-password shows login-error, successful login lands on /admin/dashboard, all four summary stat cards render, farmer master create/toggle-closed/delete via confirm dialog, purchases seeds amount preview correctly shows bags*rate (10*50=500), stock pages render for seeds/lenobag/potato, ledger + credit-notes + invoices + reports pages load, logout clears session and /admin/dashboard redirects back to /login.

issues: Radix Dialog warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` on DialogContent. Not user-visible but accessibility gap.

action_items: (Low) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to shadcn Dialog usages in CrudPage.jsx and Ledger.jsx to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/purchases and /api/sales do NOT validate that party_id / product_id refer to existing records; invalid ObjectId strings would silently save. Consider validating references.

server.py: DELETE of a purchase/sale removes linked ledger, but does not remove linked credit-note ledger cascade if credit-note references the deleted invoice via against_invoice. Not covered by data model, informational only.
server.py: PUT /purchases/{id} & /sales/{id} use `existing['invoice_no']` in the particulars but the response uses the freshly-updated doc; particulars stay consistent, OK.
CrudPage.jsx toggle(): sends the entire row (including id stripped) as PUT payload; backend filters by allowed fields so this works but sends unused data like created_at.

CORS: allow_origins=*, allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Since app uses Bearer token from localStorage this works, but the httpOnly cookie set on login won't be sent cross-origin. Not blocking current flows.
Login sets cookie with secure=True & samesite='none' which is fine for prod HTTPS; but auth relies primarily on Bearer token from localStorage as documented.
seed_data_creation: Created test vendors, farmers, companies, godowns, products, purchases, sales, credit-notes prefixed with TEST_ / UI_. Backend test fixture cleans up. UI test created UI_Vendor_*, UI_Seed_*, and a purchase draft (cancelled before save). One purchase draft may leave a UI_Vendor and UI_Seed record in DB; not affecting functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All happy-path features validated on both backend and frontend. If further tests are needed, focus on: (a) Sales PDF download via jsPDF (was not clicked in UI test to avoid file-download prompt), (b) Reports export PDF, (c) full sales flow with select dropdowns (Radix - use force click after 400ms wait), (d) Farmer Ledger auto-entry appearance after creating sales/purchases from UI. Existing UI test uses time-based unique names to avoid collisions.
